_metadata.description: P1 visualization surface: state-graph viewer, trace player, counterexample diff, and verification timeline.

requirements.title: State-graph visualizer renders a flow's state machine
requirements.description: ui/src/features/flow-detail/StateGraph.tsx renders model states + transitions as a @xyflow/react graph laid out with dagre. Selecting a node highlights incident edges; keyboard navigable.

validation.notes: StateGraph.test.tsx + StateGraph.a11y.test.tsx assert rendering, highlight on select, and axe-clean.

requirements.title: Trace player walks through Quint counterexample traces
requirements.description: ui/src/features/flow-detail/TracePlayer.tsx picks a named trace from artifact.json.traces and supports play / pause / step / reset; the graph mirrors the current step via a parent state prop (no Context).

requirements.title: Counterexample diff surfaces expected vs actual transitions
requirements.description: ui/src/features/flow-detail/CounterexampleDiff.tsx renders side-by-side expected (model) vs actual (counterexample) transitions for a failing run.

requirements.title: Verification timeline charts pass/fail rate over time
requirements.description: ui/src/features/timeline/TimelineCard.tsx fetches GET /api/v1/runs (optionally scoped by flowId), buckets runs by day, and renders a stacked recharts BarChart of passed/failed/error outcomes. Embeds in / dashboard and the Flow Detail History tab.

validation.notes: TimelineCard.test.tsx + .a11y.test.tsx assert bucketing, loading/empty/error states, axe-clean.
